source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 6 (PDF 153-174), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 (Emerging Technologies) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
6.1 Definition and Overview of Emerging Technologies

blocks.prompt:
1 Define emerging technologies. Name any two of them.
(Emerging technologies ki definition likhein. In mein se koi do ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Emerging technologies (ubharti hui technologies) woh naye tools, systems aur tareeqe hain jo abhi ban rahe hain ya jin ka istemal abhi shuru hua hai; yeh hamare jeene, kaam karne aur duniya se raabte ka andaz badal sakti hain. Misalein: Artificial Intelligence (AI) aur Blockchain.

book_ref.quote: These technologies have the potential to change the way we live, work, and interact with the world

blocks.prompt:
2 What is Artificial Intelligence? Give two tasks it can help with.
(Artificial Intelligence kya hai? Do aise kaam batayein jin mein yeh madad karti hai.)
blocks.explanation: AI (masnoi zehanat) woh machines aur software hain jo insanon ki tarah soch aur seekh sakte hain. Yeh chehre pehchanne aur bol samajhne (aur faisle karne) mein madad karti hai, jaise Siri aur khud chalne wali gaariyan.

book_ref.quote: AI can help with tasks like recognizing faces, understanding speech, and making decisions

blocks.prompt:
3 Differentiate between Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR).
(Augmented Reality (AR) aur Virtual Reality (VR) mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: AR asal duniya mein digital cheezein milati hai; VR poora virtual mahol bana deti hai.

book_ref.quote: VR creates a completely virtual environment that you can interact with using special equipment

rows: Asal duniya mein digital cheezein jorti hai
Mukammal virtual mahol banati hai
Smartphones ya glasses jaise devices istemal hote hain
Raabte ke liye khaas saman istemal hota hai
Gaming, taleem aur training mein istemal
Gaming, taleem aur training mein istemal

blocks.prompt:
4 What is the Internet of Things (IoT)? Give one example.
(Internet of Things (IoT) kya hai? Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: IoT rozmarra ki cheezon jaise fridge, gaariyon aur kapron ko internet se jorta hai taake woh data bhej aur le sakein. Misal: smart thermostat aap ka schedule seekh kar ghar ka temperature khud set karta hai.

book_ref.quote: IoT connects everyday objects, like refrigerators, cars, and even clothes, to the internet

blocks.prompt:
5 What is quantum computing?
(Quantum computing kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Quantum computers quantum physics ke usoolon se information ko aam computers se bohat tez process karte hain. Yeh aise intehai mushkil masail hal kar sakte hain jo abhi aam computers ke liye na-mumkin hain.

book_ref.quote: They have the potential to solve very complex problems that are currently impossible for regular computers

blocks.prompt:
6 What is biotechnology? Give two of its uses.
(Biotechnology kya hai? Is ke do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Biotechnology mein zinda ajsam, jaise bacteria aur plants, se nayi cheezein banai ya masail hal kiye jate hain. Istemal: nayi dawaiyan banana aur faslein behtar karna (aur mahol dost materials).

book_ref.quote: scientists are using biotechnology to develop new medicines, improve crops

blocks.prompt:
7 What is 5G technology? What will it enable?
(5G technology kya hai? Yeh kya mumkin banayegi?)
blocks.explanation: 5G wireless technology ki agli nasal hai jo bohat tez internet aur zyada qabil-e-aitbar connection deti hai. Is se mobile phones, smart devices aur AR/VR jaisi nayi technologies behtar chalengi.

book_ref.quote: This will enable better performance for mobile phones, smart devices

blocks.prompt:
8 Define cloud computing.
(Cloud computing ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cloud computing aik model hai jo internet ke zariye servers, storage aur applications jaise computing resources tak aasan rasai deta hai. Yeh resources kam se kam intizami mehnat ya provider se raabte ke saath jaldi diye aur wapas liye ja sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: These resources can be quickly provided and released with minimal management effort

blocks.prompt:
9 Give a reason: cloud computing makes it easier and cheaper to get things done.
(Wajah batayein: cloud computing se kaam karna aasan aur sasta kyun ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Apne mehnge computers aur storage devices khareedne aur sambhalne ke bajaye aap internet par cloud services istemal karte hain. Zaroorat ke mutabiq kam ya zyada istemal karein aur sirf utna pay karein jitna istemal kiya.

book_ref.quote: Instead of buying and maintaining your own expensive computers and storage devices

blocks.prompt:
10 What is virtualization? Write two of its benefits.
(Virtualization kya hai? Is ke do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Virtualization aik technology hai jo aik physical machine par kai virtual machines chalati hai, har aik ka apna operating system aur applications. Faide: hardware ka behtar istemal aur kam kharch (aur aasan management aur lachak).

book_ref.quote: It's like turning one computer into many, making it possible to do more with less

blocks.prompt:
11 Define scalability with an example.
(Scalability ki definition misal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Scalability ka matlab hai zaroorat par mazeed resources jorna. Misal: Eid ya 14 August sale par online store ka traffic bohat barh jata hai; woh mazeed servers jor leta hai taake website sust ya band na ho.

book_ref.quote: you can add more servers to handle this increased traffic

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between scalability and elasticity.
(Scalability aur elasticity mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Elasticity scalability se aik qadam aage hai kyunke is mein adjustment khud-ba-khud hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: This automatic adjustment helps keep your website running efficiently and cost-effectively

rows: Zaroorat par mazeed resources jore ja sakte hain
System mojooda demand ke mutabiq resources khud kam ya zyada karta hai
Misal: Eid sale ke traffic ke liye mazeed servers jorna
Misal: traffic barhne par servers khud jurte aur sale ke baad kam ho jate hain
Zaroorat par resources jore jate hain
Demand kam hone par resources khud kam bhi hote hain taake faltu paisa na lage

blocks.prompt:
13 What is on-demand access? Give the book's analogy.
(On-demand access kya hai? Kitab ki tashbeeh likhein.)
blocks.explanation: On-demand access ka matlab hai lambay setup ka intezar kiye baghair jab chahein computing resources istemal karna. Yeh aisa hai jaise kunwan khodne ke bajaye tap khol kar paani le lena.

book_ref.quote: without waiting for a long setup process

blocks.prompt:
14 Name the three main types of cloud services.
(Cloud services ki teen bari qismon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
2. Platform as a Service (PaaS)
3. Software as a Service (SaaS)
Har qisam control, lachak aur intizam ke mukhtalif darje deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Each type offers different levels of control, flexibility, and management

blocks.prompt:
15 What is IaaS? What does the user control in it?
(IaaS kya hai? Is mein user kis cheez par control rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: IaaS bunyadi computing infrastructure jaise servers, storage aur networking pay-as-you-go par deta hai. User operating systems, applications aur storage control karta hai, lekin neeche wala physical infrastructure nahi.

book_ref.quote: Users have control over the operating systems, applications, and storage, but not the underlying physical infrastructure

blocks.prompt:
16 Name any three IaaS providers.
(Koi teen IaaS providers ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Amazon Web Services (AWS), jo virtual servers kiraye par deta hai
2. Microsoft Azure
3. Google Compute Engine

book_ref.quote: Amazon Web Services (AWS) allows users to rent virtual servers to run their applications

blocks.prompt:
17 What is PaaS? Give two examples.
(PaaS kya hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: PaaS cloud mein mukammal development aur deployment mahol deta hai: infrastructure, middleware, development tools aur management services. Developers hardware aur software layers sambhale baghair sirf coding par tawajjuh dete hain. Misalein: Google App Engine, Heroku.

book_ref.quote: Developers can focus on coding and deploying applications without managing the hardware and software layers

blocks.prompt:
18 What is SaaS? Give two examples.
(SaaS kya hai? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: SaaS provider ki host aur manage ki hui software applications tak rasai deta hai; users sirf subscribe kar ke internet par istemal karte hain. Misalein: Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Docs, Google Drive) aur Microsoft Office 365.

book_ref.quote: SaaS provides access to software applications that are hosted and managed by the service provider

blocks.prompt:
19 Differentiate between IaaS and SaaS.
(IaaS aur SaaS mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: IaaS infrastructure deta hai jis par user operating system se oopar sab sambhalta hai; SaaS tayyar software deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Other examples are Microsoft Office 365 and Salesforce

rows: Bunyadi infrastructure deta hai: servers, storage, networking
Provider ki host ki hui software applications deta hai
User operating systems, applications aur storage control karta hai
User sirf subscribe kar ke internet par software istemal karta hai
Misal: AWS virtual servers, Google Compute Engine
Misal: Google Workspace, Microsoft Office 365, Salesforce

blocks.prompt:
20 What is the pay-as-you-go model of cloud computing?
(Cloud computing ka pay-as-you-go model kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cloud services ki qeemat istemal ke mutabiq hoti hai: jitna istemal utna paisa. Pay-as-you-go model se business zaroorat ke mutabiq resources barha ghata sakte hain, is liye yeh sasta aur lachakdar hai.

book_ref.quote: This pay-as-you-go model allows businesses to scale their resources according to their needs

blocks.prompt:
21 What is Salesforce known for? How does it help businesses?
(Salesforce kis cheez ke liye mashhoor hai? Yeh business ki kaise madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Salesforce aik bara SaaS provider hai jo apne customer relationship management (CRM) platform ke liye mashhoor hai. Yeh customer data sambhalne, sales track karne aur marketing ke kaam khudkar banane mein madad karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps businesses manage customer data, track sales, and automate marketing tasks

blocks.prompt:
22 What are cloud deployment models? Name them.
(Cloud deployment models kya hain? In ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cloud deployment models batate hain ke cloud services kaise muhayya aur istemal hoti hain; har model control, security aur lachak ke mukhtalif darje deta hai. Bare models: Public, Private, Hybrid aur Multi-Cloud.

book_ref.quote: Each model offers different levels of control, security, and flexibility

blocks.prompt:
23 What is a public cloud? Give an example.
(Public cloud kya hai? Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Public cloud internet par di jane wali cloud service hai jo kai idaron mein share hoti hai aur third-party provider ise manage karta hai. Misal: Amazon Web Services (AWS), jise har size ke business physical hardware sambhale baghair istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Businesses of all sizes can use AWS to access computing resources like virtual servers and storage

blocks.prompt:
24 What is a private cloud? Why may a large bank use it?
(Private cloud kya hai? Bara bank ise kyun istemal kar sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Private cloud sirf aik idare ke istemal ka cloud mahol hai; yeh idare ke andar ya third-party ke paas host ho sakta hai magar share nahi hota. Bara bank hassas customer data mehfooz rakhne ke liye ise istemal karta hai kyunke sirf bank ki rasai hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: This private cloud can be hosted within the bank's own data centers

blocks.prompt:
25 Differentiate between a public cloud and a private cloud.
(Public cloud aur private cloud mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Public cloud share hota hai aur sasta hai; private cloud aik idare ka hota hai aur zyada mehfooz hai.

book_ref.quote: A private cloud is a cloud environment used exclusively by one organization

rows: Internet par kai idaron mein share hota hai
Sirf aik idara istemal karta hai
Third-party cloud provider manage karta hai
Idare ke andar ya third-party ke paas host hota hai
Sasta magar kam mehfooz
Zyada mehfooz magar mehnga
Misal: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Misal: bare bank ka hassas data wala cloud

blocks.prompt:
26 What is a hybrid cloud? Give an example.
(Hybrid cloud kya hai? Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Hybrid cloud public aur private cloud ko milata hai aur in ke darmiyan data aur applications share hoti hain; is se zyada lachak aur control milta hai. Misal: company rozana kaam ke liye public cloud aur hassas data ke liye private cloud istemal karti hai.

book_ref.quote: This model provides greater flexibility and control

blocks.prompt:
27 What is multi-cloud? Why is it used?
(Multi-cloud kya hai? Yeh kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Multi-cloud mein mukhtalif providers ki kai cloud services istemal hoti hain. Is se aik provider par inhisar khatam aur reliability aur performance behtar hoti hai: aik provider mein masla ho to baqi services kaam aati hain.

book_ref.quote: This ensures that if one provider experiences issues, the company can still rely on other services

blocks.prompt:
28 Differentiate between a hybrid cloud and a multi-cloud.
(Hybrid cloud aur multi-cloud mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hybrid cloud public aur private cloud milata hai; multi-cloud mukhtalif providers milata hai.

book_ref.quote: A multi-cloud approach uses multiple cloud services from different providers

rows: Public aur private cloud ko milata hai
Mukhtalif providers ki kai cloud services istemal karta hai
Data aur applications public aur private hisson mein share hoti hain
Mukhtalif kaam mukhtalif providers ke paas jate hain
Lachak aur control deta hai
Resilience deta hai; aik provider par inhisar khatam
Misal: rozana kaam public cloud par, hassas data private cloud par
Misal: analytics Google Cloud par, enterprise apps Azure par, backup AWS par

blocks.prompt:
29 Compare the four cloud deployment models in one line each.
(Chaaron cloud deployment models ka aik aik line mein muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Har deployment model ke apne faide aur nuqsan hain jo idare ki zaroorat aur maqsad par munhasir hain.

book_ref.quote: Each cloud deployment model has its own advantages and disadvantages

rows: Public cloud
Sasta magar kam mehfooz
Private cloud
Zyada mehfooz magar mehnga
Hybrid cloud
Lachak deta hai
Multi-cloud
Resilience deta hai

blocks.prompt:
30 What is cloud storage? Name two cloud storage services.
(Cloud storage kya hai? Do cloud storage services ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cloud storage users ko data local devices ke bajaye door ke servers par rakhne deti hai, taake data kahin se bhi mile aur share ho. Services: Google Drive aur Dropbox.

book_ref.quote: This makes it easier to access data from anywhere and share it with others

blocks.prompt:
31 What is a content delivery network (CDN)? How does it deliver content quickly?
(Content delivery network (CDN) kya hai? Yeh content tez kaise pohanchata hai?)
blocks.explanation: CDN, jaise Cloudflare, cloud service hai jo website ka content duniya bhar ke users tak tez pohanchati hai. Yeh content ko users ke qareeb servers par cache (aarzi mehfooz) kar ke aisa karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Cloud computing provides the infrastructure needed to host websites and deliver content efficiently

blocks.prompt:
32 How does cloud computing help in machine learning and AI? Name two platforms.
(Cloud computing machine learning aur AI mein kaise madad karti hai? Do platforms ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cloud computing machine learning models banane, train aur deploy karne ke tools deti hai, taake data scientists aur developers bare local computers ke baghair AI hal bana sakein. Platforms: Google Cloud AI aur AWS SageMaker.

book_ref.quote: These services make it easier for data scientists and developers to create AI solutions

blocks.prompt:
33 Write any two benefits organizations get by using cloud applications.
(Cloud applications istemal karne se idaron ko milne wale koi do faide likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Cloud ki taqat istemal kar ke idare:
1. kaam ko hamwar aur IT kharch kam kar sakte hain
2. badalti zarooraton ka jaldi jawab de sakte hain

book_ref.quote: By leveraging the power of the cloud, organizations can streamline operations, reduce IT costs

blocks.prompt:
34 Write two security challenges of cloud computing and two measures against them.
(Cloud computing ke do security challenges aur un ke khilaf do iqdamat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Challenges: data breach aur ghair mutalliqa rasai (aur data ka zaya hona).
Iqdamat: encryption aur mazboot authentication istemal karein, aur security policies ka baqaida jaiza lein.

book_ref.quote: Issues such as data breaches, unauthorized access, and loss of data can occur

blocks.prompt:
35 Give a reason: resource management is essential in cloud computing.
(Wajah batayein: cloud computing mein resource management kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cloud resources demand ke saath kam ya zyada hote hain, is liye achhi resource management (istemal par nazar aur performance behtar karna) faltu kharch se bachne aur behtareen performance ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: effective resource management is essential to avoid unnecessary costs and ensure optimal performance

blocks.prompt:
36 How can users manage the cost of cloud services?
(Users cloud services ka kharch kaise control kar sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Users ko apna cloud istemal aur kharch baqaida dekhna, resources sahi baantna aur apni zaroorat ke pricing plans lena chahiye, kyunke nigrani na ho to kharch jaldi barh jata hai.

book_ref.quote: optimize resource allocation, and take advantage of pricing plans that fit their needs

blocks.prompt:
37 What is meant by compliance in cloud computing?
(Cloud computing mein compliance se kya murad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Compliance ka matlab hai ke idare ka cloud istemal qanooni aur regulatory taqazon, jaise data privacy, security aur industry ke standards, ke mutabiq ho; yeh ilaqe aur industry ke saath badalte hain. Providers in ke liye tools dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Cloud providers often offer tools and features to help meet these requirements

blocks.prompt:
38 Define blockchain.
(Blockchain ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Blockchain aik inqalabi technology hai jo distributed ledger (taqseem shuda khata) system ke zariye mehfooz aur shaffaf transactions mumkin banati hai. Yeh maloomat kai computers par record aur share karti hai, is liye ise badalna ya hack karna taqreeban na-mumkin hai.

book_ref.quote: Blockchain technology is a revolutionary concept

blocks.prompt:
39 Explain blockchain with the book's shared-notebook example.
(Kitab ki mushtarka notebook wali misal se blockchain samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Doston ka group yeh hisaab ke kis ne kis ko paisa dena hai, aik shakhs ke kaghaz ke bajaye aisi notebook mein likhta hai jis ki copy sab ke paas hai. Har tabdeeli, jaise qarz wapas karna, sab notebooks mein aik saath likhi jati hai. Blockchain isi digital notebook ki tarah kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Every time someone makes a change, like paying back money, it gets recorded in all the notebooks at the same time

blocks.prompt:
40 What is decentralization as a core principle of blockchain?
(Blockchain ke bunyadi usool ke taur par decentralization kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Roayati databases ke baraks jinhein aik markazi idara chalata hai, blockchain ko computers (nodes) ka network mil kar chalata hai jo transactions ki tasdeeq aur record karta hai. Is se single point of failure ka khatra kam aur security zyada hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Unlike traditional databases that are controlled by a central authority

blocks.prompt:
41 What is a consensus mechanism? Name two.
(Consensus mechanism kya hai? Do ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Consensus mechanism woh tareeqa hai jis se blockchain network naya block jorne se pehle transactions ke sahi hone par ittefaq karta hai; network ki kaafi aksariyat ka razi hona zaroori hai. Misalein: Proof of Work (PoW) aur Proof of Stake (PoS).

book_ref.quote: Blockchain networks use consensus mechanisms to agree on the validity of transactions

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke tamam nodes ka mutafiq (unanimous) hona zaroori hai, magar yeh ghalat chhapa hai. Asal mein kaafi aksariyat kaafi hai: PoW mein computing power ki aksariyat aur PoS mein stake ki aksariyat (aksar do tihai). Kuch nodes offline hon tab bhi block jur jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
42 Define node and ledger in a blockchain.
(Blockchain mein node aur ledger ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Node: woh computer jo blockchain network mein hissa leta hai; blockchain ki copy rakhta aur transactions aur blocks ki tasdeeq mein madad karta hai.
Ledger: blockchain ki tamam transactions ka digital record, jo tamam nodes mein phaila hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Each node maintains a copy of the blockchain and helps validate transactions and blocks

blocks.prompt:
43 What is a block? What does it contain?
(Block kya hai? Is mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Block aik saath bandhi hui transactions ka majmooa hai. Har block mein:
1. aik unique pehchan (hash)
2. pichhle block ka hawala (parent hash)
3. transactions ki list

book_ref.quote: A block is a collection of transactions that are bundled together

blocks.prompt:
44 What is a blockchain protocol?
(Blockchain protocol kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blockchain protocol woh qawaid aur tareeqe tay karta hai ke transactions ki tasdeeq kaise ho, blocks chain mein kaise jurein aur consensus kaise ho. Yeh network ki darustgi aur hifazat yaqeeni banata hai.

book_ref.quote: It ensures the integrity and security of the blockchain network

blocks.prompt:
45 Define a transaction in blockchain.
(Blockchain mein transaction ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Transaction blockchain ka aik akela indiraj (entry) hai. Yeh network ke participants ke darmiyan assets ya information ki muntaqili ko zahir karta hai.

book_ref.quote: A transaction is an individual entry in the blockchain

blocks.prompt:
46 What is a peer-to-peer (P2P) network? Give the book's example.
(Peer-to-peer (P2P) network kya hai? Kitab ki misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: P2P network aisa nizam hai jis mein computers (nodes) markazi server ke baghair seedha aapas mein raabta aur resources share karte hain; har node client aur server dono hai. Misal: file-sharing network mein users aik doosre ke computers se seedha files download karte hain.

book_ref.quote: in a file-sharing network, users can download files directly from each other's computers

blocks.prompt:
47 Name four use cases of blockchain technology.
(Blockchain technology ke chaar istemal ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Cryptocurrencies (Bitcoin, Ethereum)
2. Supply chain management
3. Healthcare (mareezon ka mehfooz record)
4. Voting systems

book_ref.quote: Blockchain technology has a wide range of applications beyond cryptocurrency

blocks.prompt:
48 How does blockchain help in supply chain management?
(Blockchain supply chain management mein kaise madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blockchain supply chain mein maal ki naqal-o-harkat ko track aur tasdeeq karta hai. Yeh shaffafiyat dhoka rokti, ghaltiyan kam karti aur products ki asliyat yaqeeni banati hai.

book_ref.quote: This transparency helps prevent fraud, reduce errors, and ensure the authenticity of products

blocks.prompt:
49 Give a reason: cryptocurrencies are important in the digital economy.
(Wajah batayein: cryptocurrencies digital maeeshat mein ahem kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh paisa badalne ka mehfooz aur decentralized tareeqa deti hain: bank ke paise ke baraks yeh blockchain se bichole ke baghair len-den mehfooz aur shaffaf rakhti hain. In se sarhad paar paisa tez aur sasta jata hai aur banks se mehroom log aalami maeeshat mein shamil hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Unlike traditional money issued by banks, cryptocurrencies use blockchain technology

blocks.prompt:
50 Write two benefits and two challenges of smart contracts.
(Smart contracts ke do faide aur do challenges likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Faide: shaffafiyat, kyunke sab fareeq sharait dekh sakte hain; security, kyunke amal blockchain yaqeeni banata hai.
Challenges: be-ghalti code ki zaroorat, aur in contracts ke jhagre hal karne ke liye qanooni nizam.

book_ref.quote: Smart contracts offer benefits like transparency, because everyone involved can see the contract's terms

blocks.prompt:
51 What are DApps? Name the platform and two areas where smart contracts are used.
(DApps kya hain? Platform ka naam aur do shobe likhein jahan smart contracts istemal hote hain.)
blocks.explanation: DApps decentralized applications hain jo developers Ethereum jaise platforms par smart contracts se banate hain. Smart contracts finance aur insurance (aur supply chain aur real estate) jaise shobon mein istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: These contracts can be used in many areas, such as finance, supply chain management, real estate, and insurance

blocks.prompt:
52 How does blockchain track the origin of a product?
(Blockchain product ke manba ka peecha kaise karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Supply chain ki har transaction decentralized ledger par likhi jati hai, is liye raw material supplier se aakhri customer tak har qadam ka peecha ho sakta hai aur woh badal nahi sakta (jaise supplier se manufacturer tak record banta hai). Customer yeh tareekh dekh kar product ka manba tasdeeq karta hai.

book_ref.quote: from the raw material supplier to the final customer, is traceable and immutable

blocks.prompt:
53 How does blockchain help financial services?
(Blockchain financial services ki kaise madad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Banks aur financial services blockchain se len-den tez aur mehfooz banate hain. Misal: bairoon-e-mulk paisa bhejna aam taur par sust aur mehnga hai; blockchain ise tez aur sasta bana deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Banks and financial services use blockchain to make transactions faster and safer

blocks.prompt:
54 Differentiate between manual and blockchain-based verification of academic certificates.
(Academic certificates ki manual aur blockchain wali tasdeeq mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Blockchain wali tasdeeq manual tareeqe se tez, zyada mehfooz aur dhoke se zyada mehfooz hai.

book_ref.quote: This process can be time-consuming, prone to errors, and susceptible to fraud

rows: Jaari karne wale idare ko darkhwast di jati hai jo haath se tasdeeq karta hai
Jaari karne wala idara certificate decentralized ledger par likhta hai
Waqt lagta hai
